item.title: VAMPANERA ~Zetsubou no Chikarou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Distortion
  • 発売日: 2005-12-16
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: VAMPANERA ～絶望の地下牢～
  • 英語名: VAMPANERA Zetsubou no Chikarou

あらすじ

The lord of the land lies dead from illness and his wife is chosen to be the successor. Soon into her reign she is told of a demonic text which–with the proper ceremony–can grant the reader immortality. With this she could bring back her husband. There’s just one key element that is missing–the blood of a virgin. A “Virgin Hunt” is soon instated and the higher-ups begin looking for the best candidates. Who will be sacrificed to the demons for the “greater good”? Are they tampering with forces beyond their control?

item.title: D'erlanger ~Yuuwaku no Inma Byoutou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Distortion
  • 発売日: 2005-01-21
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: D’ERLANGER ～誘惑の淫魔病棟～
  • 英語名: D’erlanger Yuuwaku no Inma Byoutou

别名

  • D’ERLANGER（デランジェ）～誘惑の淫魔病棟～

あらすじ

You play as a patient who awakes every night to find the hospital becoming a hellish place–only wake up the next morning and seeing that everything seems normal again. You find out that the bizarre world you visit is called “Mirage”, and that both you and a fellow patient travel there every night. There are those amongst the hospital staff who are trying to tap into this realm; it’s up to you to find out exactly who, and what you’re going to do about it.
